Visit website Pricing Freemium Free plan included Platforms Web, macOS, API API available Launched 8 July 2024 First public release Reviewed by Tomás Beltrán 16 October 2026 The review, written by Tomás Beltrán after using it for real work. Review bots usually comment on everything. Ramo comments on very little, and when it does, it is usually right. It reads the whole repository, so its notes reference other files: this function is called with null in the billing module, that query skips an index you added last month. On our test repo it caught two bugs our own review missed. The first index of a large monorepo takes hours. After that, reviews arrive in under a minute.
